**Ferdinand Zvonimir von Habsburg**

It was Prince Hans-Adam of Liechtenstein's birthday. The ruler of the small European state was 75 years old but he looked good for his age. Ferdinand had been invited to the celebration due to his father, Karl von Habsburg, being the Austrian diplomat for Liechtenstein. It didn't quite sit right with Ferdinand, the once great house of Habsburg reduced to simple diplomats. Although, even that was progress. Previously, no Habsburg was permitted to hold political office. The 22 year sighed and took another sip of his wine. There weren't many people his age who would enjoy these stuffy, formal events, but Ferdinand appreciated the tradition of it all. Still, he would much prefer to be out with his friends in Vienna on a Friday night. Although, with it being Valentine's Day he would prefer not to be constantly reminded his own romantic failures. Being a Habsburg required attendance to events such as these, taking up time the average young man would be spending looking for a lady. On the occasions he did find time with the opposite sex, it was blatantly obvious that all they were interested in was the name Habsburg and the riches associated with it.

As Ferdinand finished his drink, he headed back to the bar area. On the way he saw Hans-Adam and a young woman talking to his father. The woman looked bored, while the two older men were engaged in conversation. Ferdinand ordered another drink at the bar. He found himself being drawn to his father's conversation. He was too far away to hear anything, especially with the many discussions around him. His attention was on the woman standing with the Liechtensteiner prince. She must have been around his age, a year or so older at most. She was wearing a plain but stylish blue dress, showcasing her hourglass figure. Her long blond hair fell to her mid-back, framing the soft features of her face perfectly. As she excused herself from the conversation and headed to the bar, Ferdinand caught her eye. He looked away sheepishly, embarrassed by his staring. A smirk crossed the woman's lips. The young Habsburg looked into his drink as she sashayed across the room, her movement exaggerating her curves.

'Like what you see?'

Ferdinand heard as he lifted his head up to see the beautiful blonde stood in front of him. Ferdinand started to stutter an apology, before the woman burst into laughter.

'I can't believe you don't recognise me. It was only 5 years ago Ferdinand!'

He looked more closely at her face, realising who she was.

'Princess Marie-Caroline, its a pleasure to see you again.'

'Cut the formal crap! I've already had enough of that tonight.'

Marie-Caroline was the daughter of Prince Alois, heir to Liechtenstein and was Prince Hans-Adam's granddaughter. The two had met five years earlier at function held by the King of the Netherlands. They had spent most of that evening together, chatting about the latest gossip from Europe's royalty, laughing and joking about the ridiculousness of all the formalities. Marie-Caroline had been one of the few girls who he had felt really comfortable with, she wasn't interested in just his name or wealth. She already understood what it felt like to be on the receiving end of that. The Princess had been pretty back then, but since then she had truly blossomed into the beautiful young woman that now stood before him. He could feel his cheeks start to flush as they continued to catch up. They took their drinks to a nearby couch, where they continued to talk late into the night.

----------

'Ferdinand, we are leaving' said Karl von Habsburg as he rounded the corner. He turned to see the two young nobles curled up on the couch, chatting like good friends.

'Ah Princess, that is where you got to. I hope my son hasn't been boring you with his talk of cars!'

She chuckled as she got up from the couch.

'It was a pleasure to see you again Ferdinand.'

'The pleasure is all mine Princess.'

The young woman leant forward, kissing Ferdinand on the cheek. Ferdinand longingly watched her walk away, back towards the main room. Karl saw his son stare as the young woman made her way back into the hall. He knew the look on his son's face, he had the same expression when he saw his ex-wife Francesca for the first time.

'Come on then, its time we went home.'

----------

Ferdinand had not stopped thinking about the night as they made the journey back to the hotel. He couldn't put his finger on it but he just felt warm and happy. It was probably all the alcohol that he had drunk. He went straight to his hotel room, the nights events had worn him out. As he took off his suit jacket, a small piece of paper fell out of one of the pockets. Frowning, he picked it up. Turning it over he saw a string of digits with the phrase 'call me =)' written below. Ferdinand smiled.
